raw_text: [[File:{{{Alt}}}|28px|link=]] For the spawned units, see Snake Bracelet/Snake . For the troop counterpart, see Snake Barrel . "Summons snakes that fight by your side when taking damage" Contents 1 Summary 2 Strategies 2.1 Offensive Strategies 2.2 Defensive Strategies 3 Statistics 4 History 5 Audio 5.1 Generic 5.2 Unique 6 Trivia 6.1 Comparison Summary [ ] The Snake Bracelet is an Epic piece of Equipment for the Barbarian King . It was first seen in the "Snake It Back" event challenge on February 5, 2025, and made its debut in the Snake Festival event on February 7, 2025. Since April 15, 2025, it can be obtained from the Trader for 1,500 Gems. The Snake Bracelet appears to be an open metallic golden bracelet that appears to be two snakes that are joined to each other, with a turquoise glow. The Barbarian King summons Snakes whenever he takes 300 points of damage; if he takes more than 300 damage in a single hit, he can summon multiple Snakes at a time. The number of Snakes that can be summoned through the Snake Bracelet is limited. In addition, the Snake Bracelet grants the Barbarian King increased damage per second, hitpoints, and attack speed. Strategies [ ] Offensive Strategies [ ] It is recommended to upgrade the Snake Bracelet to level 15 or 18, as he will gain an additional 8 Snakes at these levels to the summoning limit, allowing him to distract defenses more often. There are different interactions when the Barbarian King is paired with other Equipment with the Snake Bracelet: The Spiky Ball greatly increases the base stats of the King, the massive total max health helps him to survive clearing buildings around the base and deal lots of damage in combination with the Snakes, with a powerful ability that can clean up the last of the buildings. This combination outclasses everything in this usecase: The Barbarian Puppet only provides similar max health comparable to Spiky Ball with no damage boost, with the ability being useless as the Barbarians cannot do as much as Spiky Ball, while Snakes already provide protection at a steady stream. Even then, the snake's usefulness is just a bonus because of higher Town Halls have more splash damage which can quickly defeat all the Snakes and Barbarians, with the stat boosts of the Snake Bracelet being the main highlight. The Rage Vial ability mostly recovery his health only, as the extra damage and speed cannot do as much damage as Spiky Ball. The King being outside means the Earthquake Boots ability is way less effective, removing Walls and allowing the King to enter deeper into the base can be a detriment to this role as he is alone most of the time and can get focus fired. The King being outside also means Giant Gauntlet ability is way less effective as he does not need to tank heavy damage nor have multiple buildings within reach to deal splash damage, and Snakes spawn at a lower rate during the ability because of the damage reduction as they spawn every 300 damage taken. The Vampstache is mostly a novelty, on paper they have great synergy, both making the King attacking faster to heal more (which may let him tank more damage than Spiky Ball max hitpoint increase) and have more health to spawn Snakes. However, there is a maximum amount of Snakes that can be spawned, and the extra damage and attack speed from Vampstache already cannot overtake the passive damage increase of Spiky Ball, not even counting the total damage Spiky Ball's ability can do. Be careful of splash, multi-target, and fast attack defenses such as Bomb Towers , X-Bows , Multi-Target Inferno Towers , Scattershots , Multi-Archer Towers , Firespitters , Giga Inferno , and Inferno Artillery , as the Snakes will be destroyed due to their low health. Be careful when the Barbarian King is near a Single-Target Inferno Tower or Monolith , as the damage can quickly destroy the Barbarian King. Consider having a Lightning Spell , Freeze Spell , or Overgrowth Spell on hand to stun, freeze, or disable them and potentially splash defenses, retargeting the Snakes, providing massive amount of distraction. Units that can stun defenses like Diggy and Battle Drill can also be helpful to stun them. If the Barbarian King is damaged beforehand and has released Snakes, these summoned units can distract the Inferno Tower momentarily. Should the Barbarian King continue to sustain damage via other sources (such as a nearby Ricochet Cannon ) and release more Snakes, these spawns can continue to stall the Inferno Tower and possibly prevent it from locking on until they run out. Defensive Strategies [ ] When defending against a Barbarian King with the Snake Bracelet and Vampstache, place high-hitpoint buildings such as the Gold and Elixir Storages, a high-damage defense such as the Single-Target Inferno Tower or Monolith to potentially knock the King out and splash defenses like Scattershots, Wizard Towers, and Bomb Towers to deal with the remaining Snakes, as well as traps to help take them down. Inferno Towers and Monolith can devastate the Barbarian King wielding the Snake Bracelet easily; however, the Snakes that he spawns can in return destroy Inferno Towers and the Monolith without a struggle. Be sure to keep splash defenses or traps around to deal with the horde of Snakes. When initially unlocked and equipped, the Barbarian King attacks every 1.188 seconds. When maxed out, he attacks every 1.091 seconds. With the max Vampstache , he can attack every 0.909 seconds. Comparison [ ] Out of all the Hero Equipment, the Snake Bracelet gives the most hitpoint increase to a Hero , surpassing the Barbarian Puppet .
